mapper.select: select patient_id from base_patient where concat(IFNULL(name,''),IFNULL(pinyin_name,''),IFNULL(mobile,'')) like concat(concat('%',#{combination}),'%')

SELECT patient_id patientId, first_visit_date firstVisitDate, first_visit_doctors firstVisitDoctors, first_visit_outpatient firstVisitOutpatient, cumulative_consumption cumulativeConsumption, last_visit_date lastVisitDate, last_visit_doctors lastVisitDoctors, last_visit_outpatient lastVisitOutpatient, total_arrears totalArrears, number_of_visits numberOfVisits FROM base_patient WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT bp.id, bp.`name`, bp.gender, bp.mobile, bp.medicalNumber, bp.age, bp.faceUrl, btp.dentistId, btp.lastVisit, btp.lastVisitTime FROM ( SELECT bp.patient_id AS id, bp.`name`, bp.face_url AS faceUrl, bp.mobile, bp.medical_number AS medicalNumber, bp.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF( YEAR, bp.birthday, CURDATE()) AS age FROM base_patient bp WHERE concat( IFNULL( bp.`name`, '' ), IFNULL( bp.medical_number, '' ), IFNULL( bp.pinyin_name, '' ), IFNULL( bp.mobile, '' )) LIKE concat( concat( '%', #{query.patientKeyWord} ), '%' ) LIMIT 0, 10 ) bp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp1.patient_id, btp1.registered_dentist_id AS dentistId, btp1.employee_name AS lastVisit, btp1.treat_start_time AS lastVisitTime FROM ( SELECT max( btp.treatment_id ) AS treatmentId FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY btp.patient_id ) btp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp.treatment_id, btp.patient_id, btp.registered_dentist_id, btp.treat_start_time, be.employee_name FROM base_treatment_process btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY btp.treatment_id ) btp1 ON btp.treatmentId = btp1.treatment_id ) btp ON bp.id = btp.patient_id
